description:
Frozen, unmigrated verbatim copy of crnk-data-jpa on javax.persistence/Hibernate 5/QueryDSL 4 - exists
    solely so crnk-setup-spring-boot2 has a JPA-glue module it can depend on. Not actively migrated or
    maintained beyond keeping it compiling - see crnk-data-jpa for the supported jakarta.persistence/
    Hibernate 6 integration.
